deviations: Work-run and evidence ids are validated as [A-Za-z0-9_-]{6,64} (the id prefix format was not given); mission and project ids keep the strict msn_/prj_ + 24 hex forms.

Project POST sends environmentId only when the form field is filled and testCommand only when the argv list is non-empty; the current server schema (additionalProperties:false, environmentId required) must accept both (Lane B contract).
Reject from REPORTING offers only BLOCKED because the state machine does not allow REPORTING -> REMEDIATING; the action list is computed from the state-machine copy.
While the modal confirm dialog is open the top-bar ACIL DURDUR is inert (native modal); Esc or Vazgec closes the dialog first. The STOP control itself stays visible and is never hidden.

Run status and reviewer verdict labels use a dictionary with raw-value fallback; the set of active run states (QUEUED, LEASED, STARTING, RUNNING, VERIFYING, REVIEWING) is a copy used only to list live runs and should be confirmed against Master V2 section 06 at integration.
Güvence kind filter and verification filter are client-side over the current server page (limit 100); paging uses the server cursor.
